name: Heat or energy recovery ventilator (HRV/ERV)

comps.spec: Two blower motors, one moving fresh air in and one moving stale air out. ECM (PMSM) on recent units: the Broan V180H75RT unit as a whole is rated 120 V, 3 A, 200 W and drew 22–121 W across its listed airflow tests (Broan spec sheet)
comps.loc: Each end of the cabinet, behind the door

comps.spec: Blower wheels on the two motors
Heat-exchange core: a block of thin cross-flow plates where the two air streams pass without mixing. Polypropylene on the Broan V180H75RT; aluminium or plastic plates on others
comps.loc: Centre of the cabinet; slides out

comps.spec: Washable filter or filters (MERV 8 on the Broan V180H75RT)
comps.loc: Beside or in front of the core

comps.spec: Motorised dampers, including the defrost damper
comps.loc: Behind the duct collars on top

comps.spec: Microprocessor control board, wired to a wall control
Temperature sensing that starts defrost at about −5 °C (23 °F) outdoors (Broan)
Condensate drain and hose to a floor drain
Three-prong 120 V power cord, about 1.8 m (6 ft)

buildings.loc: Basement mechanical room, often hung from the joists near the furnace
In-suite closet or ceiling in condos and new apartments

notes: In a tight house the HRV is how fresh air gets in; with the power off it stops, and a house built to keep air from leaking gets little fresh air, so pollutants build up. That matters most when anyone burns anything inside. Broan says its HRV is not designed to provide combustion or dilution air for fuel-burning appliances (Broan quick start), and a burner in a tight house needs its own air: Beckett says an oil burner can't burn its fuel properly without a reliable combustion air supply, and where exhaust fans or a dryer could pull the room below outdoor pressure it wants air piped to the burner or a sealed enclosure (Beckett AFG). So give any unvented heater a cracked window (EPA improving IAQ) and keep a battery CO alarm on, in the hallway outside the bedrooms (Health Canada CO). Tight buildings let pollutants build up unless they have mechanical ventilation (EPA intro IAQ). When it runs, keep its two outside hoods clear of snow. The core, filters and ECM motors are good salvage.
